name: kadaliao
description: Claude Code mods by kadaliao: function-hook plugins that change Claude Code's own interface and behaviour

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A two-row status band: model, folder, git branch, context window, tokens, cache rate, API cost, tokens/s and TTFT

plugins.name: prompt-en
plugins.description: English under each prompt: a translation when you write in another language, corrections or other ways to say it when you write in English, and a vocabulary book to review them

plugins.name: danmaku
plugins.description: Bilibili-style bullet comments that fly across a few lanes above the prompt, heckling what Claude does as it works

plugins.name: ambience
plugins.description: Sounds for what Claude does (commands, edits, tests, commits, a finished turn), a notification after a long turn, and a live tally of the turn's work under the prompt
